name: VectorizeLoop
description: Transform scalar loop into vector operations using SIMD instructions (AVX2), with proper handling of loop remainder.

parameters.name: target_loop_tag
parameters.description: Tag identifying the target loop operation to vectorize (e.g., 'innermost_loop', 'reduction_loop'). Used to match the operation in the transform dialect.

parameters.name: vector_width
parameters.description: SIMD vector width in elements. For AVX2: use 8 for FP32, 4 for FP64. Must be a positive power of 2.
